findings.summary: The badpath check uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so a member like ../out_evil/x resolves to a sibling directory and bypasses the path traversal filter.
The rar filter copies the same startswith-without-separator badpath logic, allowing the same path traversal bypass.
The 7z filter copies the same startswith-without-separator badpath logic, allowing the same path traversal bypass.
If every 7z entry is blocked, targets is an empty list, and py7zr may treat an empty list as no filter, which would extract all the blocked entries.
Blocked members are only logged with logger.error and skipped, so extraction reports success and callers get a partial result with no exception.
badlink in the 7z filter is dead code because its only call site is commented out, and its logic is wrong anyway because it checks os.path.basename(filename) as the link target.
